summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K) attaching an October 1, 2026 press release announcing the immediate appointment of Arnd Christ as Chief Financial Officer and executive board member, effective October 1, 2026. He succeeds Bart Van Rhijn, who steps down after five years. No compensation, severance, equity, transition period, or interim-CFO terms were disclosed, and no board recommendation or advisor was named. Christ previously served as CFO of Nasdaq-listed Immatics N.V. from October 2020 to September 2025. The abrupt same-day CFO swap followed a Nasdaq- and Euronext-listed biotech's 'defining point' language; watch for subsequent 6-K disclosures on severance, any accounting or disclosure disagreement, and whether the change precedes financing or partnering activity given Christ's transaction background.
